entries.description: While wandering in search of oil
entries.subject: While wandering

spans.text: While wandering in search of oil, they tried heaping sand in a bucket, sprinkling it little by little with water, and pressing it out.
While wandering in search of milk, they tried pulling the horn of a newly-calved cow.
While wandering in search of butter, they tried pouring water into a pot and churning it with a stick.
While wandering in search of fire, they tried drilling a green, sappy log with a drill-stick.
